description: This file defines the JpaTemplateDomainService class, which implements the TemplateDomainService interface. It provides methods for managing Template objects, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion within a transactional context. It also handles JSON commands to modify templates and interacts with a TemplateRepository for persistence.

classes.name: JpaTemplateDomainService
classes.description: Implementation of TemplateDomainService that manages Template entities via a repository, supporting CRUD operations and JSON command processing.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Template entities from the repository.

methods.name: findOneById
methods.description: Finds a Template by its unique identifier, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new Template entity from a JSON command, persists it, and returns the result.

methods.name: updateTemplate
methods.description: Updates an existing Template entity based on provided JSON data and saves it.

methods.name: removeTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a Template entity by its ID.

methods.name: updateTemplate
methods.description: Saves the provided Template entity and flushes the changes.

methods.name: getAllByEntityAndType
methods.description: Retrieves Templates filtered by entity and type.
